operators.title: Transport Time
operators.summary: Playback time in seconds, with speed and offset controls.

operators.title: Beat Clock
operators.summary: Tempo-locked phase, beat pulse, and bar phase signals.

operators.title: Auto Selector
operators.summary: Advances a switch index on a deterministic timed interval.

operators.title: Oscillator
operators.summary: A normalized repeating control signal.

operators.title: Constant
operators.summary: A fixed control value for parameters and calculations.

operators.title: Math
operators.summary: Combines two control values with a basic operation.

operators.title: Map Range
operators.summary: Remaps a control value between numeric ranges.

operators.title: Smooth
operators.summary: Eases rising and falling control changes over time.

operators.title: Pointer
operators.summary: Stage coordinates plus held, press, and release signals.

operators.title: AI Chat
operators.summary: Live text instructions for a connected generative model.

text.label: Prompt
text.defaultValue: A luminous living landscape, fluid motion, cinematic color

operators.title: XY Pad
operators.summary: A hands-on pair of normalized control signals.

operators.title: Audio Level
operators.summary: Starts the microphone, reports its loudness, and passes the block on for analysis.

operators.title: Audio Spectrum
operators.summary: Splits a patched audio source into bass, mid, and treble control signals.

operators.title: Audio Trigger
operators.summary: Turns rises above a band’s own recent average into a gate and a decaying envelope.

operators.title: Audio Beat Clock
operators.summary: Infers tempo and beat phase from the spacing between incoming triggers.

operators.title: Video Input
operators.summary: A live camera frame from this browser session.

operators.title: Network Video
operators.summary: Receive HLS, MPEG-DASH, or WebRTC (WHEP) video as a WebGL2 frame texture.

operators.title: File
operators.summary: A local image, video, or audio file selected in this browser session.

operators.title: Audio Output
operators.summary: Routes a connected audio block to this browser tab after activation.

operators.title: Audio Mixer
operators.summary: Mixes 2, 4, or 8 audio sources with per-source gain and three-band EQ.

operators.title: Video Model
operators.summary: Receives generated frames from a compatible worker or API gateway.

operators.title: ComfyUI Generate
operators.summary: Queue an allowlisted ComfyUI workflow on a local or remote server and show the generated image or clip.

operators.title: Solid Color
operators.summary: A uniform RGBA frame with individually controllable channels.

operators.title: Gradient
operators.summary: Linear, radial, or conic gradients with up to eight RGBA stops.

operators.title: Shape
operators.summary: Antialiased 2D primitives on a transparent frame.

operators.title: Vector Shape
operators.summary: Draw layered vector artwork or import a static SVG file.

operators.title: Text
operators.summary: Live text with embedded fonts, wrapping, alignment, and RGBA color.

operators.title: Noise
operators.summary: Seeded value, simplex, cellular, curl-field, and fractal textures.

operators.title: Shader Source
operators.summary: Constrained GLSL ES 3.00 fragment body with declared uniforms and static budgets.

source.label: GLSL body

operators.title: Flow Field
operators.summary: A fluid procedural color field.

operators.title: Cells
operators.summary: An animated cellular noise field.

operators.title: Transform 2D
operators.summary: Moves, scales, and rotates a frame around an adjustable pivot.

operators.title: Projector Mapping
operators.summary: Draw a vertex quad on the frame and remap it with a planar projection.

operators.title: Warp
operators.summary: Distorts a frame with a flowing coordinate field.

operators.title: Blur
operators.summary: Softens a frame with a bounded single-pass filter.

operators.title: Threshold
operators.summary: Extracts an opaque grayscale matte from a selected channel.

operators.title: Mask
operators.summary: Uses one frame channel to shape another frame’s transparency.

operators.title: Composite
operators.summary: Layers two frames with standard source and destination rules.

operators.title: Frame Switch
operators.summary: Selects one of four frame inputs by rounded index.

operators.title: Source Selector
operators.summary: Selects one of four frame inputs with colored buttons or a trigger.

operators.title: Blend
operators.summary: Combines two frame signals.

operators.title: Trails
operators.summary: Accumulates an internally delayed previous frame.

operators.title: Spiral Feedback
operators.summary: Rotates and zooms retained history into a spiralling frame.

operators.title: Strobe
operators.summary: Rhythmically gates a frame with internal rate capped at 3 Hz.

operators.title: Color Grade
operators.summary: Adjusts hue, exposure, contrast, and saturation.

operators.title: Chromatic Aberration
operators.summary: Radial RGB separation and lens distortion with explicit edge handling.

operators.title: Liquid Morph
operators.summary: Displaces and morphs two textures; Mix and Phase are patchable positions, not internal clocks.

operators.title: Bloom / Glow
operators.summary: Bounded 25-tap bright-pass glow in working RGB; not HDR tone mapping.

operators.title: Scanlines
operators.summary: Pixel-spaced scanlines and RGB phosphor stripes; preserves source alpha.

operators.title: Levels
operators.summary: Remaps black and white points, gamma, lift, and gain; output is clamped.

operators.title: HSV / HSL
operators.summary: Adjusts hue, saturation, and value or lightness while preserving alpha.

operators.title: Luma Key
operators.summary: Removes dark or bright regions by multiplying source alpha with a soft luminance key.

operators.title: Chroma Key
operators.summary: Keys a chosen RGB color by chrominance distance with soft edges and spill suppression.

operators.title: Crossfade
operators.summary: Interpolates two frames with alpha-correct curves; Mix is the position, not a clock.

operators.title: Displace
operators.summary: Offsets source UVs using map red/green channels; no map leaves the source unchanged.

operators.title: Edge
operators.summary: Sobel luminance edges with clamped borders and source alpha.

operators.title: Pixelate
operators.summary: Samples square pixel blocks without changing the output resolution.

operators.title: Tile / Kaleidoscope
operators.summary: Repeats, mirrors, or folds a frame into aspect-correct polar symmetry.

operators.title: Channel Shuffle
operators.summary: Routes source channels, luminance, zero, or one into each RGBA output.

operators.title: Liquid Metaballs
operators.summary: Colliding Matter.js particles refract and mask a frame; patch Pointer X/Y to attract the cluster.

operators.title: Particle Transition
operators.summary: Instanced textured tiles scatter from A to reveal B; Mix scrubs deterministic trajectories, not a free-running simulation.

operators.title: Text Source
operators.summary: A bounded reusable text literal, committed with Apply.

operators.title: Text Format
operators.summary: Join, literal replace, or format a template using {text}, {other}, and {value}.

operators.title: Number to Text
operators.summary: Explicit decimal formatting of a scalar control.

operators.title: Text to Number
operators.summary: Strict decimal parsing to a finite control; errors return the saved fallback.

operators.title: JSON Parse
operators.summary: Parse bounded text into immutable JSON; malformed input returns null and an error.

operators.title: JSON Select
operators.summary: Select an own property or array item using JSON Pointer, such as /items/0/name.

operators.title: JSON to Text
operators.summary: Serialize JSON, or emit a selected string without quotes.

operators.title: CSV Parse
operators.summary: Parse quoted CSV into a bounded string table; supports editable literal data.

operators.title: Table to CSV
operators.summary: Serialize a table as CSV with spreadsheet formula escaping.

operators.title: Table Transform
operators.summary: Filter by literal substring, select a column, or stable-sort strings.

operators.title: Table Cell
operators.summary: Read one table cell as text for explicit numeric conversion or text rendering.

operators.title: Table Join
operators.summary: Bounded inner equijoin with left/right-prefixed column names; duplicate keys retain all matches.

operators.title: Fetch
operators.summary: Explicit credential-free HTTP GET with CORS, timeout, cancellation, and bounded text response.

operators.title: WebSocket
operators.summary: Explicit text connection and send, latest bounded message, and manual reconnect.

operators.title: Server Events
operators.summary: Explicit EventSource connection receiving default message events as bounded text.

operators.title: Storage
operators.summary: Explicit read/write/delete of browser-local namespaced text; never writes automatically.

operators.title: Inspect
operators.summary: Data demand root showing a bounded latest-value snapshot, not an unbounded log.

operators.title: Vector 2
operators.summary: Compose 2 scalar controls into an explicit vector.

operators.title: Vector 3
operators.summary: Compose 3 scalar controls into an explicit vector.

operators.title: Vector 4
operators.summary: Compose 4 scalar controls into an explicit vector.

operators.title: Split Vector 2
operators.summary: Split a vec2 into scalar controls; missing input is zero.

operators.title: Split Vector 3
operators.summary: Split a vec3 into scalar controls; missing input is zero.

operators.title: Split Vector 4
operators.summary: Split a vec4 into scalar controls; missing input is zero.

operators.title: Primitive 3D
operators.summary: Bounded box, sphere, plane, or cylinder mesh in right-handed world units.

operators.title: Grid / Line 3D
operators.summary: Bounded XY point grid or X-axis connected line; point size is set by PBR Material.

operators.title: Transform 3D
operators.summary: Compose local pivot/scale/XYZ rotation/translation onto mesh and point descriptors; 16 levels maximum.

operators.title: Camera 3D
operators.summary: Perspective or orthographic camera looking at a world-space target; Y up.

operators.title: Light 3D
operators.summary: Directional, point, or ambient light; Render 3D accepts three explicit light inputs.

operators.title: PBR Material
operators.summary: PBR mesh shading; point/line primitives use unlit base color. Frame texture is patched on Render 3D.

operators.title: Asset 3D
operators.summary: Reference an imported static GLB/glTF scene asset with an explicit placement transform; the asset is resolved from durable storage.

operators.title: Instance 3D
operators.summary: Expand one imported scene placement into a bounded GPU instance batch (64 maximum) in a grid or ring layout; placement stays editable per node.

operators.title: Render 3D
operators.summary: Render one mesh and one point/line descriptor with three lights into a transparent frame. Optional frame input supplies the mesh base-color map.

operators.title: Control to Bool
operators.summary: Explicit threshold conversion from a scalar to sustained boolean state.

operators.title: Bool to Control
operators.summary: Explicit boolean conversion to saved low/high scalar values.

operators.title: Compare
operators.summary: Numeric equality, inequality, or inclusive range test; returns a boolean.

operators.title: Logic
operators.summary: AND, OR, XOR, or NOT on explicit boolean inputs.

operators.title: Trigger
operators.summary: Converts boolean changes to ordered events. Initial state seeds without firing.

operators.title: Event to Control
operators.summary: Turns a nonempty event batch into a scalar pulse stretched by the saved duration.

operators.title: Gate
operators.summary: Choose between two scalar inputs using a boolean; route events only while open.

operators.title: Hold / Latch
operators.summary: Track a value while open; closing retains the last value. Reset uses Initial.

operators.title: Sample & Hold
operators.summary: Capture the current scalar on each event; Reset wins at equal timestamps.

operators.title: Counter
operators.summary: Count ordered increment/decrement events with wrap or clamp; Reset wins ties.

operators.title: Random
operators.summary: Seeded event-sampled random scalar; reset restarts the same sequence.

operators.title: Timer
operators.summary: Event-started timer with progress, repeat, pause, cancellation, and bounded completion events.

operators.title: Envelope
operators.summary: Event-driven attack/hold/release envelope with cancel, pause, and repeatable reset.

operators.title: Timed Transition
operators.summary: Start or reverse an eased scalar transition from its current value. Cancel holds the current value.

operators.title: Step Sequencer
operators.summary: Eight saved steps on the visual transport clock; tempo changes preserve phase, late ticks retain newest events.

operators.title: Cue Scheduler
operators.summary: Ordered timestamped value cues on the visual transport. Same-time array order wins; no project mutation or device I/O.

operators.title: Signal Number
operators.summary: Numeric demand-root monitor with an unscaled readout, configurable-range meter, and unchanged scalar output.

operators.title: Signal Text
operators.summary: Text demand-root monitor; preview is limited to 2048 characters, output passes the complete input unchanged.

operators.title: Signal Edge
operators.summary: Boolean state, leading/rising and falling edge counts; initial state seeds without counting an edge.

operators.title: Signal Bang
operators.summary: Flash and count incoming events, forward them, or click to fire a manual event. Works without Display.

operators.title: Display
operators.summary: Presents a frame on the stage.
